paper: Romero SA et al. J Physiol 2016;594(17):5009-23, PMID 27061420 (update: PMID 29455450, J Physiol 2018;596(6):1103)
evidence_basis: PubMed abstract only (no full text available) plus GEO series description
assay: bulk RNA-seq, Illumina HiSeq 2500 (GPL16791), STAR 2.4.0i to GRCh38 / Ensembl 78, HTSeq-count 0.6.1
samples: 48 = 16 subjects x 3 time points (pre, immediately after, 3 h after one 60-min bout of moderate single-leg knee-extension exercise); 8 control (no drug), 8 combined H1/H2 histamine-receptor blockade before exercise
repeated_measure_unit: subject (3 biopsies per subject); drug is between-subject
primary_estimand: Exercise effect on the muscle transcriptome over time within subjects (post vs pre), and the difference in that response between control and H1/H2 blockade (time x drug)
planned_contrasts: control: immediately post vs pre and 3 h post vs pre (abstract: exercise DE >3000 protein-coding genes; exact per-contrast split not in abstract)
control vs blockade post exercise (abstract: 795 genes differentially expressed between control and blockade)

paper_threshold.source_locator: abstract has no threshold; full text unavailable

paper_method: not stated in abstract (GEO: STAR + HTSeq-count; DE tool not named)
note: GEO overall_design: alignments re-run with updated software, updated DE tables and protein-coding counts deposited 2016-08-30 and reported in PMID 29455450; the abstract figures are from the original 2016 analysis
